name: Ittoki Otoya
source:
Otoya is an energetic, cheerful and kind boy. He is a positive and friendly person who enjoys singing and playing sports.
Despite his age, he acts like a child and is always straightforward and honest. 
He is afraid of heights and plays the guitar.

He shares a room with Tokiya from Class S and is in Class A.
